draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on my last note — I see you've already got an invite out to a teammate, which is a good start.

The next step is usually the first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through setting up that first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
